There were remaining issues with spacing. I repaired them. But it is important that you pay attention to that in the future.

The paragraph on procedure use actually appears to cover two coaching opportunities . I separated into bullets to make it clear. This adds to the quantity.

Overall - this is good and shows engagement and value additions. The tracking of open issues meets our WOW factor, as it is over and beyond what her own staff would do.

IMPORTANT - The teams version still has our comments. Download and remove the comments before sending over to Ashley. Double check that the comments are gone. Consider it a critical task :)

ALSO IMPORTANT - Let me know how she responds. I am also still trying to learn how she interprets things.
